## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Spanish-language checkers game with a board rotated 45° and pieces arranged on opposite sides.

## Requirements
- Deliver the game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented local two-player checkers; Marfil starts.
- Used standard checkers rules: forward diagonal moves, mandatory captures, multi-jumps, kings, win detection, undo, and restart.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game UI, styling, and checkers logic in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `app.js`.
- Verified 64 board cells, a legal opening move, turn change, and undo in the browser.
- Checked the mobile layout at 390×844; no horizontal overflow.
- Saved `screenshots/dama.jpg` at 1280×900 and checked browser console errors: none.
- `node --check app.js` passed.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Report the game complete and briefly note the local two-player rules assumption.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Spanish-language game interface and rules dialog.
- `style.css`: rotated board, visual design, and responsive layouts.
- `app.js`: board setup, rules, turns, captures, undo, and restart.
- `screenshots/dama.jpg`: latest visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Opening position has 12 pieces per side on alternating playable squares in the first and last three rows.
- The game server is available at `http://localhost:3002`.

Verified the opening move and undo, checked the mobile layout at 390×844, and saved the latest 1280×900 screenshot to `screenshots/dama.jpg`. No browser console errors. Assumption: local two-player play, with Marfil starting.
